name: 94158 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94158 (San Francisco) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94158 (San Francisco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94158 (San Francisco) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
